label: churn100-s5
resisted: Nothing structural. Dead units (states 5 and 15 chain); three always-on affine units; state:9 gate active on 3 rows; account-length hinge nearly inert; state:20 a near-cancelling pair; the two service-call gates overlap heavily.
tool_bugs: compute_performance at full sample >110 s (rerun in background). KernelSHAP noise floor ~3e-4.
summary: P(churn) = sigmoid(-2.455 + linear backbone + two service-calls x low-day-charge gates + high-day-minutes hinge + small account-length hinge + single-state offsets), additive. Service calls enter only through the gates: about +1 to +1.4 logit per call when day charge is below its median, nothing in the top quartile. Day-minutes hinge +1.46 logit above p90. Reproduces the empirical pattern (4+ calls, low day charge: 0.90-1.00 churn; high day charge: 0.19-0.20).

performance_sources.conclusion: Almost all of +0.065 from the service-calls x low-day-usage interaction (two overlapping gates, 0.063 together).

rare_category_switches.logit_effect: -0.15 mean (range -0.85 to +1.13); also enters the service-call gate

rare_category_switches.note: Logit effects track the in-sample calibrating offsets closely and exceed the raw log-odds offsets: fitted to train state means. All states off costs 0.0073 train AUC.
